# Manage and More Design System

> Brand guidelines, design tokens and assets for Manage and More (endorsed brand of UnternehmerTUM). Sources: 2020 brand guideline PDF in source/ (print, identity) and the manageandmore.de codebase (screens, adopted 2026-10-07).

## Start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how agents use and extend this repo
- [Skill](skills/manage-and-more-brand/SKILL.md): brand essentials and review checklist
- [Asset catalogue](assets/catalog.json): every logo, label, icon, illustration, photo, font
- [Tokens](tokens/build/tokens.flat.json): colours, type, spacing, radii, layout, motion
- [Tailwind v4 theme](tokens/build/tailwind.theme.css)
- [Playground](playground/README.md): Vite + React app with token-driven Foundations pages and design-language variants layered over core tokens

## Two brands
- Brand v1, the programme (manageandmore.de, print): [assets/](assets/README.md), [tokens.css](tokens/build/tokens.css), guidelines 01–14, [example page](examples/landing-page.html)
- Brand v2, tech products (hackathon platform, CRM, SaaS): [guidelines/15-brand-v2.md](guidelines/15-brand-v2.md), [assets/v2/](assets/v2/README.md) (same file names, blue #0071E3, no accent), [variant tokens](tokens/build/variants/brand-v2.css), [example page](examples/brand-v2.html), [hairline figures](examples/hairline-figures.js)
